pathogenesis: reactivation of latent herpes simplex virus or varicella zoster virus within geniculate ganglia causes neuropathy with cytotoxic edema induced by neuronal inflammation
diagnostic_methods: magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) showing facial nerve enhancement
prognosis: most patients either partially or completely recover within 3 weeks to 3 months, up to 30% of the patients have long-term sequelae such as permanent facial weakness
